clues.text: The firstborn of Rebekah's twins, he came out red and covered with hair like a fur coat.
Famished after coming in from the field, he swore away his birthright to his brother for lentil stew.
A skillful hunter and man of the field, he was loved by Isaac, who had a taste for wild game.
When blind Isaac blessed his younger brother instead, he let out a loud, bitter cry: "Bless me too, O my father!"
Holding a grudge over a stolen blessing, he planned to kill his brother once their father's days of mourning came.
Years later, coming with four hundred men, he ran to his brother, embraced and kissed him, and they both wept.
He and his brother had too much livestock to live together, so he moved his household to Mount Seir.
